functions.name: Log
functions.doc: Writes `text` to the engine's logger at `level`: 0 Info, 1 Warn, 2 Error. The text is data, never a format string.

functions.name: TimeDeltaTime
functions.doc: The length of the frame being run, in seconds.

functions.name: TimeTickRate
functions.doc: The fixed tick's length, in seconds.

functions.name: EntityIsValid
functions.doc: Whether the entity is alive in the active scene.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.doc: The entity; one another scene's list owns is not alive here.

functions.name: EntityWorldTransform
functions.doc: The entity's world transform (FenrirECS GetWorldTransform), composed through its parents on each call.

returns.doc: False when the entity is not alive or has no Transform.

parameters.name: world
parameters.doc: The world transform; the default Transform when the entity is not alive or has none.

functions.name: EntitySetWorldTransform
functions.doc: Sets the entity's Transform so its world transform is `world` (FenrirECS SetWorldTransform). Component data only, so it takes effect at once.

returns.doc: False, touching nothing, when the entity is not alive or has no Transform.

functions.name: ComponentIdOf
functions.doc: The id of the native component registered under `name` for the C# type `typeName` (its full name). An id is good only for the registry generation it was looked up in: a new Scripting has a new registry.

returns.doc: The id, or a RegistryError as its value: NotRegistered when nothing is registered under the name, WrongType when it is registered for a different C# type (so a script cannot claim a native component with a struct of its own).

functions.name: RegisterScriptComponent
functions.doc: A script assembly reports a component type it defines, while it loads.

returns.doc: False when nothing is loading.

functions.name: RegistryGeneration
functions.doc: Which registry ids belong to: it changes every time a registry is created.

functions.name: ComponentGet
functions.doc: A pointer to the entity's component in the engine's storage, good until the engine next changes its storage.

returns.doc: Null when the entity is not alive or does not have it.

functions.name: ComponentHas
functions.doc: Whether the entity is alive and has the component.

functions.name: EntityCreate
functions.doc:
A new entity, alive and usable at once; it gets its engine components when changes play back.

The structural changes (this, EntityDestroy, ComponentAdd and ComponentRemove) never touch the engine's storage: each is recorded and played back, in order, when the native code that called into the script gets control back, so a Ref<T> taken before stays valid.

returns.doc: Whether one was made: false when there is no active scene.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.doc: The new entity, owned by the active scene's list; no entity (the default Entity, C#'s Entity.None) when none could be made.

functions.name: EntityDestroy
functions.doc: Records the entity's destruction, for playback.

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: EntityNotAlive, or NotActive when scripting is not running.

functions.name: ComponentAdd
functions.doc: Records adding the component to the entity, for playback.

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: EntityNotAlive, Unknown (no such component), ReadOnly, or NotActive when scripting is not running.

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: The component's bytes, or null for a default one.

functions.name: ComponentRemove
functions.doc: Records removing the component from the entity, for playback.

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: EntityNotAlive, Unknown (no such component), ReadOnly, Required (the engine needs every entity to have it), or NotActive when scripting is not running.

functions.name: ChangesApply
functions.doc: Plays back the structural changes recorded since the last time. The system runner calls it after each system.

returns.doc: How many changes were applied.

functions.name: ChangesDiscard
functions.doc: Drops the structural changes recorded since the last time, and destroys the entities they created.

functions.name: EventIdOf
functions.doc: The id of the event registered under `name` for the C# type `typeName`. Each event is a queue the engine owns: the queue C++ SendEvent and EventReader use for a native event.

returns.doc: The id, or a RegistryError as its value: NotRegistered when there is none, WrongType when it is registered for a different C# type.

functions.name: RegisterScriptEvent
functions.doc: A script assembly reports an event type it defines, while it loads.

returns.doc: False when nothing is loading.

functions.name: EventSend
functions.doc: Records an event to send when the system returns (see ChangeBuffer::SendEvent).

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: Unknown (the event has no queue), or NotActive when scripting is not running.

functions.name: EventReadAfter
functions.doc: One read of a C# EventReader. Readers share no state: each keeps its own cursor in C#. The addresses are good until something is sent to the queue or it swaps.

returns.doc: False when there is no such event.

parameters.name: seen
parameters.doc: The reader's cursor: how many of the queue's events it has gone past (all ones, the engine's NewReaderCursor, before its first read), moved past what the read yields.

parameters.name: view
parameters.doc: Five values written: the older part's address and count, the newer part's address and count, and how many events the reader missed.

functions.name: QueryCount
functions.doc: How many entities have every component in `ids`: an upper bound on the rows QueryFill writes. A query is this call and QueryFill however many entities match; a row is the entity (a Fenrir::Entity, `sizeof(Entity)` in words, with its scene's list set) followed by the address of its component for each id, in order.

returns.doc: The count; negative when an id is unknown.

functions.name: QueryFill
functions.doc: Writes up to `capacity` rows of the entities that have every component in `ids` (see QueryCount).

returns.doc: How many rows it wrote; negative when an id is unknown.

functions.name: ResourceIdOf
functions.doc: The id of the native resource registered under `name` for the C# type `typeName` (its full name), good only for the registry generation it was looked up in.

returns.doc: The id, or a RegistryError as its value: NotRegistered when nothing is registered under the name, WrongType when it is registered for a different C# type.

functions.name: ResourceGet
functions.doc: A pointer to the resource in the engine's storage (the active scene's, for a scene resource), good until the engine next changes its storage.

returns.doc: Null when there is none now.

functions.name: ResourceInsert
functions.doc: Records inserting the resource, replacing the one there is, for playback.

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: Unknown (no such resource), ReadOnly, or NotActive when scripting is not running.

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: The resource's bytes, or null for a default one.

functions.name: ResourceRemove
functions.doc: Records removing the resource, for playback.

returns.doc: None when recorded, otherwise why it was refused: Unknown (no such resource), ReadOnly, or NotActive when scripting is not running.
